# **River Dolphin Pink**

River Dolphin Pink is a Vancouver-based band creating nostalgic and dreamlike songs. Drawing on childhood memories of growing up in Alberta, alongside relationships and everyday moments, the five-piece writes music that feels like snapshots from a journal while never sacrificing honesty. Their songs turn small details into vivid, sincere, and slightly surreal stories, balancing real world observation with playful imagery and a sense of humour. RDP’s sound sits between indie rock, folk, pop and twee with a  focus on catchy vocal melodies. Their live shows are a spectrum from high energy to sweet and tender feelings, with an unpolished, playful stage presence that aims to be authentic. Their performances welcome a feel that pulls audiences in to the set to get people dancing and laughing. With a growing presence in Vancouver’s local music scene, River Dolphin Pink is currently working on recording their first album.
